newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank of N.Y. buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bank of N.Y. buy reiterated.

text.p: Bank of New York Co Inc's earnings would get a boost and its stock would likely command a higher share price-to-earnings ratio if it is able to acquire State Sreet Boston Corp, analyst George Salem of Gerard Klauer Mattison said in a research report Friday.
"We believe a Bank of New York/State Street Boston merger is a clear possiblity, and we strongly applaud such a deal," Salem said.
The analyst said he has calculated that Bank of New York can afford to pay $80-per share for State Street Boston.
Salem said that based on an $80 per share purchase price, an acquisition would add four to five percent to Bank of New York's projected 1998 earnings of $3.25 per share.
He said he assumes 40 percent cost savings on State Street's total expense base.
Salem noted that there are risks which could prevent a merger from happening including antitrust, regulatory prohibition and conflicts over management roles.
State Street Boston was up 7-1/8 to 70-1/8 just before the midsession and Bank of New York was up 5/8 to 33-7/8.
